# Empty function length controls

These fixtures retain the existing core support for `Len` of an empty-domain
function (#527), including function-set emission, non-1 empty interval bounds,
empty tuples and a nonempty sequence control. The core already canonicalizes
empty function keys to `IntFcn` at lower bound 1; no runtime fix is needed.

`oracle.json` contains seven compact success facts generated by the official
harness against the pinned oracle. Three non-sequence rejection streams remain
unclassified (context-only nested-expression endings), with no golden or error
agreement credit. Tests require their original unverified evaluation-error result
and preserve Auto/reference behavior.

`core_len_empty.rs` checks both profiles, worker widths 1/4, Core/Auto/Reference
and disabled folding/memoization/hash-consing. The historical MCFindHighest
fallback is verified separately against its existing pinned golden. These facts
supply no full-tier or performance acceptance claim.
